# MalayalamChat Online (മലയാളം ചാറ്റ്)

> MalayalamChat (https://malayalamchat.online/) is Kerala's #1 free anonymous Malayalam chatting website and Mallu stranger chat platform. It connects Malayalees worldwide for live Kerala chat rooms, Malayalam roundam chating, anonymous stranger calling, and 1-on-1 WebRTC video calls with zero registration, zero coin paywalls, and zero phone number verification.

## Primary Services & Features

- [MalayalamChat Homepage](https://malayalamchat.online/): Kerala's #1 Malayalam chatting website, Mallu chat room, live Malayalam chat, & free video call platform.
- [Malayalam Chatting Website](https://malayalamchat.online/malayalam-chatting-website): Kerala's top online chatting website for free anonymous chat and random calling.
- [Malayalam Chat Online](https://malayalamchat.online/malayalam-chat-online): Real-time Malayalam and Manglish group discussions, public Kerala rooms.

- [Mallu Chat Rooms](https://malayalamchat.online/mallu-chat-rooms): Public and private Malayalam chat rooms & chatroom lobbies for Kerala districts and Gulf NRIs.
- [Mallu Video Call](https://malayalamchat.online/mallu-video-call): Encrypted 1-on-1 HD Mallu video calling with zero downloads or subscriptions.
- [Mallu Chat Website](https://malayalamchat.online/mallu-chatting-website): Live Kerala community chat lobbies and rooms without registration.
- [Live Mallu Chat](https://malayalamchat.online/mallu-chat-live): Real-time live Malayalam chat rooms and instant stranger video call matching.
- [Mallu Stranger Chat Website](https://malayalamchat.online/mallu-stranger-chat-website): Anonymous 1-on-1 text messaging and stranger video calling for Malayalis.
- [Mallu Random Chatting Website](https://malayalamchat.online/mallu-random-chatting-website): 1-click random stranger matching, Malayalam roundam chating, and WebRTC video calls.
- [Mallu Free Video Calling Website](https://malayalamchat.online/mallu-free-video-call): High-definition peer-to-peer WebRTC voice and video calling.
- [Mallu Random Video Calling Website](https://malayalamchat.online/mallu-random-video-call): Single-click random video matching with online Kerala strangers.
- [Mallu Chat App](https://malayalamchat.online/mallu-chatting-app): Web-based progressive web application interface and Android APK download.
